class_features.name: Bardic Inspiration
class_features.summary: (PHB-2024 59) As a Bonus Action, you can inspire another creature within 60 ft. that can see or hear you. That creature gains one of your Bardic Inspiration dice (1d6).

class_features.name: Spellcasting
class_features.summary: (PHB-2024 59) You can cast spells through your bardic arts. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for your Bard spells (Spell DC 15, Spell Attack +7). You can use a Musical Instrument as a Spellcasting Focus for your Bard spells.

class_features.name: Expertise
class_features.summary: (PHB-2024 60) You gain Expertise in two skill proficiencies of your choice.

class_features.name: Jack of All Trades
class_features.summary: (PHB-2024 60) You can add half your Proficiency Bonus (1) to ability checks you make that uses a skill proficiency you lack and that doesn’t otherwise use your Proficiency Bonus.

class_features.name: Beguiling Magic
class_features.summary: (PHB-2024 65) You always have Charm Person and Mirror Image prepared. In addition, immediately after you cast an Enchantment or Illusion spell using a spell slot, you can cause a creature you can see within 60 ft. of you to make a DC 15 Wis.

class_features.name: Mantle of Inspiration
class_features.summary: (PHB-2024 65) As a Bonus Action, you can expend a use of Bardic Inspiration, rolling a Bardic Inspiration die (1d8). When you do, choose up to +4 creatures within 60 ft. of yourself.

class_features.name: Font of Inspiration
class_features.summary: (PHB-2024 61) You now regain all expended uses of Bardic Inspiration when you finish a Short or Long Rest. In addition, you can expend a spell slot (no action required) to regain one expended use of Bardic Inspiration.

racial_traits.name: Resourceful
racial_traits.summary: (PHB-2024 194) You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

racial_traits.name: Skillful
racial_traits.summary: (PHB-2024 193) You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

racial_traits.name: Versatile
racial_traits.summary: (PHB-2024 194) You gain an Origin feat of your choice.

racial_traits.name: Languages
racial_traits.summary: (PHB-2024 37) Your character knows at least three languages: Common plus two languages you roll or choose from the Standard Languages table.

feats.name: Lucky
feats.summary: (PHB-2024 201) Luck Points. You have 3 Luck Points that you can spend on the benefits below. You regain expended Luck Points after a Long Rest.

feats.name: Tough
feats.summary: (PHB-2024 202) When you take this feat, your HP maximum increases by 10.
